user.title: Connect to Jellyfin
user.description: Enter your Jellyfin server URL and an API key. Create an API key in Jellyfin under Dashboard → API Keys.

data_description.url: Base URL including protocol and port, for example http://192.168.1.10:8096
data_description.api_key: API key from the Jellyfin dashboard
data_description.name: Optional display name for this server

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Jellyfin
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {name} ({url}) is no longer valid. Enter a new API key.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Jellyfin. Check that the server is running and port 8096 (or your custom port) is reachable from Home Assistant

abort.already_configured: This Jellyfin server is already configured
abort.wrong_account: The API key belongs to a different Jellyfin server
